description: `--output json cli run list --help` prints one envelope line: result.help is the help text and result.operations the run.list manifest record, so a suggested help command still parses.

result.help:
Usage: prose [GLOBAL OPTIONS] cli run list [OPTIONS]

List runs, newest first, one page at a time.

Options:
  --limit N                   Page size, 1 to 200. Default: 20.
  --before CURSOR             Opaque cursor from a previous result's nextBefore.
  --json                      Print one JSON result; the same as the global --output json.
  --help                      Show help for this command.

Examples:
  prose cli run list --limit 10 --json

Output: openprose.service-operation/1 (--json).
Paging: pass the result's nextBefore to --before for the next page.
Exit codes: 0 success; 2 invalid invocation or configuration; 10 service or credential error; 24 interrupted.

options.description: Opaque cursor from a previous result's nextBefore.
options.name: --before
